messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: StreamlineAI renewal kickoff — onboarding playbook & QBR scheduling

Hi Aliya / Streamline team,

Thanks for the continued partnership — excited to kick off the renewal conversation for your June 30 contract anniversary. Goal for this thread: align on term choices, proposed capacity uplift, and lock a QBR/demo week so we can sync execs and ops.

Quick outline:
- Timeline: target amendment executed by 2027-06-20 to allow one week of pre-production staging.
- Capacity ask: current committed tokens + planned burst pools for holiday spike (we estimate +40% peak).
- Stakeholders: please confirm who should be on the QBR (billing, SRE, PO, procurement).
- Next steps: we propose a 60-minute QBR in week of 5/24 or 5/31; happy to adapt.

Attachments: [Attachment: draft_sow_streamline.pdf (PDF, 48KB)] — includes high-level SOW change for capacity and a proposed staggered billing schedule.

Please reply with: 1) stakeholder list and titles, 2) preferred QBR week/time windows, 3) any procurement deadlines we should be aware of.

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
Strategic Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: (415) 555-0192

---
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform for predictable latency and costs.

Evelyn — thanks for the clear note. Couple quick items from our side:

1) Stakeholders: Raj Patel (CIO), Neela Rao (Head of ML Ops), and myself (Head of Product). Procurement will be looped for contracts (procurement@streamline.ai).

2) Capacity: we increased production traffic in March; see attached usage snapshot (Q1). We're comfortable with a 30–50% headroom plan, but would like a short call with your technical lead to validate burst assumptions and potential model-variant fallbacks.

3) QBR: week of 5/31 is preferable for exec alignment — mornings PT work best.

Attached: [Attachment: usage_report_q1.csv (CSV, 120KB)].

Can you confirm whether the proposed billing staircase (monthly ramp) in the SOW can be revised to a quarterly staircase? Procurement will likely request that.

Best,
Aliya

Subject: Re: StreamlineAI renewal kickoff — onboarding playbook & QBR scheduling

Aliya / team — quick technical readout from infra and onboarding:

- Burst profile: the Q1 snapshot looks consistent with a short-tail spike pattern. We can support +50% peak with a step-up pool and prefix caching, but we'll need to pin a model-family variant for fallback (recommend: gpt-medium-quant).
- Staging window: to validate latency under commit, we recommend a 72-hour smoke test on the reserved pool the week prior to go-live.
- Billing cadence: switching to quarterly staircase is doable; ops will need to know the exact commit dates to provision GPU pools.

I've attached a capacity profile with estimated GPU-hours and suggested throttle thresholds.

Attachments: [Attachment: capacity_profile_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 240KB)].

Proposed internal plan: short pre-QBR technical sync (30m) the week before the exec QBR to align on telemetry dashboard and runbooks. Evelyn — I can lead that call if you want.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
